description: TabFree test corpus: permissively licensed Tableau files from official tableau/* GitHub repositories. See corpus/README.md.

kinds.twbx: packaged workbook (zip holding a .twb, plus extracts/images)
kinds.tdsx: packaged data source (zip holding a .tds, plus extracts)
kinds.tdvt-expr: TDVT expression test: one Tableau calc per line (setup.*.txt)
kinds.tdvt-expected: TDVT expected results for an expression test (expected.setup.*[.N].txt)
kinds.tdvt-data: TDVT TestV1 test data or table DDL/load scripts

sources.license_note: The repository root holds both LICENSE (MIT, 2016) and LICENSE.txt (Apache-2.0, added 2026-06-25 in 'Add Salesforce Open Source Template files'). Both are kept and both are complied with.
